name: US Census Bureau Data API
rate_limits: 500 requests/day without key (soft limit); higher with free API key; no published hard cap
notes: Over 1,600 API endpoints covering ACS, Decennial Census, Economic Census, Population Estimates, International Database, and more. Free API key via api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html. Works without key for basic queries. Excellent for AI: deeply structured geographic/demographic data at multiple resolution levels (national, state, county, tract, block group). Three companion services: Data API (statistics), TIGERweb (geographic boundaries), Geocoder (address-to-coordinates). Example: https://api.census.gov/data/2023/acs/acs5?get=NAME,B01003_001E&for=state:*
